top_rigor_problems: Macarian homilies voiced as desert teaching (F4-P): the record explicitly forbids 'one of us said' and says no record shows desert monks carried them in this window.
Harness leak: F2-E grades the build ('this turn's ground', 'THIN GROUND notes') instead of answering, and adds an unsourced 'authenticity is contested' claim.

Caveats dropped in transit: Nepheros (Melitian) used as evidence for 'our' economy without its caveat (F6-I), undated Kellia structures and Cassian's psalmody given without their bounds (F5-E), Cassian's semi-Pelagian bound dropped (F1-T).
top_access_problems: Engine-cut lead-ins and orphans: 'Some time later he heard...' (C-I), 'is this.' with nothing after (C-P), 'how we named the path itself' (F2-I), 'That saying' (F2-T), 'The greatest among us is one clear case' (F4-I).

Record pasting: whole records reused off-question (never-settled in F3-P, origins in F3-T and F4-E, the full withdrawal story in F4-T), which pads answers and causes misframes like 'You ask who started us'.
System vocabulary reaching participants: 'this turn's ground', '[[thin:liturgy]]', 'our record' (F2-E, F6-E, C-P).
world_summary.cost_note: Output cost is driven by a few answers padded with whole records: F4-I (529 words, ~300 beyond need), F3-T (419, ~230), F2-E (~200), F4-T (393, ~200), F3-P (~140), F4-E (~120). C-I is the cost outlier ($0.092, no cache read) despite a normal length. Most other answers are 200-320 words and roughly fit their questions.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close but not yet. The records are unusually careful and most answers (16 of 28) are accurate, honestly hedged and readable; the honest-limit answers (F1-P, F2-P, F5-P, F6-T) are a real strength. Two answers must not ship: F4-P passes the Macarian homilies off as desert teaching, and F2-E leaks the harness. Ten more need craft fixes, mostly sentences cut mid-thought and whole records pasted in off-question. The most valuable single fix is in the engine: stop sentence-level cuts from leaving orphaned pronouns and announced-but-missing content, and stop pasting whole record texts when only part of one answers the question. That would clear most FIX verdicts and cut output tokens at the same time.
